signin.availability: Always shown. It works only for an account that already exists. Type your email address, then type the code we send you.

steps.action: Read what biohack.it is for. From here you can start, sign in, open the ecosystem page or open the documentation.

Choose "Get started". Sign-up and sign-in are the same page. An email code does not create a new account. A new account is created today only when you continue with the forum button, on a site that has it switched on.
Choose "Sign in" and pick one of the sign-in methods below.

If you start from "Get started" and sign in with an email code or a passkey, a welcome page opens. It explains that your profile is public by default. If you sign in with a provider button, you go to the dashboard address instead.
The ecosystem page lists the open projects and open data that biohack.it reuses.
The documentation index links to the AI surfaces map, the architecture page and this guide.
